_comment: Gestes de small talk du point du jour. group: A = A1/A2, B = B1, C = B2+. 'move' guide le coach (anglais), 'labelFr' s'affiche au bilan. Rotation serveur, jamais deux fois de suite.

A.move: say three simple things about their day today (what they did, in the past simple)
A.labelFr: Raconter ta journée en trois phrases

A.move: say what they are going to do this evening or this weekend (going to)
A.labelFr: Dire ce que tu vas faire

A.move: say how they feel today and why (I'm tired because…)
A.labelFr: Dire comment tu te sens, et pourquoi

A.move: ask the coach a simple question back (And you? / What about you?)
A.labelFr: Renvoyer la question

A.move: say what they like and don't like (I like… / I don't really like…)
A.labelFr: Dire ce que tu aimes et n'aimes pas

A.move: describe their usual morning (I usually… / then I…)
A.labelFr: Décrire ta routine du matin

A.move: talk about the weather and what it changes for them today
A.labelFr: Parler de la météo sans être ridicule

A.move: say what they ate or will eat today (simple food vocabulary)
A.labelFr: Parler de ce que tu manges

A.move: say they didn't understand and ask to repeat (Sorry, can you say that again?)
A.labelFr: Dire que tu n'as pas compris

A.move: talk about someone in their family or a friend (who they are, what they do)
A.labelFr: Parler d'un proche

A.move: say where they live and one thing they like about it
A.labelFr: Parler de l'endroit où tu vis

A.move: say what they do at work or in their studies, in two sentences
A.labelFr: Parler de ton travail ou de tes études

A.move: react to something the coach says (That's nice! / Really? / Oh no!)
A.labelFr: Réagir à ce que dit l'autre

A.move: say what time they do things today (at 7, in the morning, after lunch)
A.labelFr: Situer ta journée dans le temps

A.move: say what they can and can't do well (I can… / I'm not good at…)
A.labelFr: Dire ce que tu sais faire

A.move: talk about a hobby and how often they do it (once a week, every day)
A.labelFr: Parler d'un loisir et de sa fréquence

A.move: say what they need to buy or do soon (I need to… / I have to…)
A.labelFr: Dire ce que tu dois faire

A.move: say what they watched, read or listened to recently and if they liked it
A.labelFr: Parler d'un film, livre ou musique

A.move: ask for an opinion or advice simply (What do you think? / Should I…?)
A.labelFr: Demander un avis

A.move: say goodbye naturally and wish something (Have a nice evening!)
A.labelFr: Prendre congé naturellement

B.move: tell what happened today with a bit of detail and sequence (first…, then…, in the end…)
B.labelFr: Raconter ta journée avec un fil

B.move: talk about plans and how sure they are (I'll probably… / I might… / I'm planning to…)
B.labelFr: Parler de tes projets avec des nuances

B.move: give an opinion and one reason (I think… because…)
react with interest and ask a follow-up question (Oh really? How did it go?)
B.labelFr: Relancer sur ce que dit l'autre

B.move: compare two things (better than, not as… as)
talk about an experience they've had (present perfect: I've been to… / I've never…)
describe a small problem and how they solved it
B.labelFr: Raconter un petit problème et sa solution

B.move: talk about a habit they want to change (I should… / I'm trying to…)
say how long they have been doing something (for / since)
explain what they do at work and what they like or dislike about it
B.labelFr: Expliquer ton travail et ce que tu en penses

B.move: describe a place they like and why it matters to them
B.labelFr: Décrire un lieu qui compte pour toi

B.move: make a suggestion to the coach (Why don't you…? / You could…)
talk about the news or something they heard recently, without technical words
express a wish or regret (I wish… / I should have…)
B.labelFr: Exprimer un souhait ou un regret

B.move: describe a person's character in a few words
say they're not sure and buy time naturally (Let me think… / That's a good question)
talk about what they would do with a free day (would)
disagree politely (I see what you mean, but…)
talk about a goal and the steps to get there
B.labelFr: Parler d'un objectif et des étapes

B.move: summarise their week in three sentences

C.move: tell an anecdote from today with a punchline, using past continuous and past simple together
nuance an opinion (to some extent, on the other hand, it depends on…)
speculate about the future (it's likely that… / I doubt… / chances are…)
describe a decision they made and the trade-offs
C.labelFr: Expliquer une décision et ses compromis

C.move: react to a story with empathy and a precise follow-up (That must have been… / How did you handle it?)
talk about something that annoys them, with humour
explain a work topic to a non-expert in simple terms
use a conditional about the past (if I had…, I would have…)
give feedback to the coach on an idea, tactfully
describe a trend they notice around them (more and more people…, it seems that…)
tell what they're looking forward to and why (looking forward to + -ing)
C.labelFr: Dire ce que tu attends avec impatience

C.move: disagree and propose an alternative in one breath
use two idioms naturally while talking about their week
talk about a cultural difference they've noticed between France and English-speaking countries
paraphrase when a word is missing instead of stopping (it's a kind of… / the thing you use to…)
talk about a book, film or podcast and what it says about people
C.labelFr: Analyser une œuvre en deux phrases

C.move: negotiate something small with the coach (a time, a plan) and reach a compromise
describe how they've changed over the last few years (used to / these days)
express mild frustration professionally (I'm a bit concerned that…)
wrap up the conversation themselves, summarising and saying goodbye
